human_actions_pending.action: Decide Finding 1: fix the help kill-switch gap, or accept and ship
human_actions_pending.context: HelpController.Index carries [FeatureFlagGate("tool.help.enabled")]; HelpController.Topic does NOT — Topic only checks per-topic RequiresFlag. With tool.help.enabled OFF, /help 404s but /help/{slug} for any topic whose RequiresFlag is null stays live. The sitemap already hides them (SitemapController checks HelpFeatureFlagKey), so this is a kill-switch integrity gap, not an SEO leak. Fix = add [FeatureFlagGate("tool.help.enabled")] to HelpController.Topic plus a test asserting 404 when the flag is off.
